# Waste Info

> A directory of local recycling and waste services in the UK, organised by
> town and by service category. Waste Info lists real, working businesses —
> skip hire, house clearance, scrap collection, and similar services — with
> contact details and the materials/services each one covers.

## Site structure

- [Home](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/): search by postcode/town, browse by service category.
- [All locations](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/locations/): every town covered.
- [All categories](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/categories/): all service categories, with listing counts.
- [Oxford](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/oxford/): example town page — every listing in one town.
- [Skips & Containers](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/categories/skips-and-containers/): example category page — every listing in one category, across all towns.
- [Skip Hire in Banbury](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/banbury/skips-and-containers/): example town+category page — listings for one category within one town. These pages exist only where at least one matching listing exists.
- [Blog](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/blog/): news, updates, and guides.
- [Get listed](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/get-listed/): how a business gets added to the directory.

## Data

Each listing includes: name, town, one or more categories, one or more
services offered, materials accepted (optional), and contact details
(address, postcode, phone, website) where known. Listing data is embedded
per-page as `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD (schema.org).

## Full page list

See [the sitemap](https://wasteinfo.co.uk/sitemap-index.xml) for the complete, current set of URLs.
